title: Add customer review system with submission form and public display

requirements.summary: Create a new ReviewsSection component positioned after the AboutSection in the App.tsx layout
acceptanceCriteria: ReviewsSection component exists in frontend/src/components/
Component is imported and rendered in App.tsx after AboutSection
Section has a distinct visual design consistent with existing sections

file_operations.description: Create ReviewsSection component with consistent section styling using existing color palette from tailwind.config.js. Include section header with title and description, container for review submission form, and display area for submitted reviews. Use concrete-inspired colors and match the styling patterns from AboutSection and ServicesSection.

Import ReviewsSection component and add it to the layout immediately after AboutSection and before ContactSection. Maintain existing component order: Navigation, HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ReviewsSection (new), ContactSection, Footer.

requirements.summary: Build a review submission form in the ReviewsSection component with fields for star rating (1-5), customer name, service type dropdown, and written feedback textarea
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes star rating selector with 1-5 star options
Form includes text input for customer name
Form includes dropdown for service type matching existing services (Patio Polyaspartic Coating, Driveway Polyaspartic Coating, Pool Deck Polyaspartic Coating, Garage Floor Polyaspartic Coating)
Form includes textarea for written feedback about customer experience
Form has validation requiring all fields before submission
Form displays success message after successful submission

file_operations.description: Add review submission form with star rating selector (interactive 1-5 stars), customer name input field, service type dropdown with options matching ContactSection (Patio Polyaspartic Coating, Driveway Polyaspartic Coating, Pool Deck Polyaspartic Coating, Garage Floor Polyaspartic Coating), and feedback textarea. Implement form validation following the pattern from ContactSection.tsx requiring all fields before submission. Add success message display after successful submission using the useSubmitReview mutation hook. Include loading state during submission and error handling.

requirements.summary: Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for submitting reviews and fetching all reviews from the backend actor
acceptanceCriteria: useSubmitReview mutation hook calls backend submitCustomerReview function
useGetAllReviews query hook calls backend getAllReviews function
Query automatically refetches after successful review submission
Hooks follow existing pattern from useQueries.ts

file_operations.description: Add useSubmitReview mutation hook that calls backend submitCustomerReview function with parameters (id, rating, customerName, serviceType, feedback). Add useGetAllReviews query hook that calls backend getAllReviews function to fetch Array<CustomerReview>. Configure mutation to invalidate the getAllReviews query on success for automatic refetch. Follow existing pattern from submitQuoteRequest and getAllRequests hooks using useActor, useMutation, and useQuery.

requirements.summary: Display all submitted reviews in the ReviewsSection component showing star rating, customer name, service type, feedback text, and submission date for each review
acceptanceCriteria: Reviews displayed in card layout with visual hierarchy
Star rating shown visually (filled/empty stars)
Customer name and service type clearly labeled
Feedback text displayed prominently
Reviews sorted by date with newest first
Empty state shown when no reviews exist yet
Loading state shown while fetching reviews

file_operations.description: Add reviews display using useGetAllReviews hook. Render reviews in card layout with visual hierarchy showing filled/empty stars for rating, customer name with service type label, feedback text prominently displayed, and formatted submission date from timestamp. Sort reviews by timestamp with newest first. Include empty state message when no reviews exist and loading spinner while fetching. Use card styling consistent with ServicesSection cards and concrete-inspired color palette.
